chunks.translation: The Supreme Cosmic Being has a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, and a thousand feet.
Encompassing the universe on all sides, He transcends it by ten fingers' breadth.

chunks.sanskrit: पुरु॑ष ए॒वेदꣳ सर्वम्᳚ । यद्भू॒तं यच्च॒ भव्यम्᳚ ।
chunks.translation: The Purusha alone is all this universe — whatever has been, and whatever is to be.
He is the Lord of Immortality, who grows beyond all by means of manifest sustenance.
Such is His magnificent glory; and greater than all this is the Supreme Purusha Himself.
A fourth of Him constitutes all created beings; three-fourths remain immortal in the transcendent realm.
Three-fourths of Purusha ascended above; one-fourth manifested here again in cosmic creation.
Thence He spread out in all directions, pervading both that which eats (animate) and eats not (inanimate).
From Him was born the cosmic egg (Viraj); and from Viraj manifested the cosmic Person.
Having manifested, He extended beyond the earth, both behind and in front.
When the Devas performed the primordial sacrifice with Purusha as the offering:
Spring was the consecrated clarified butter, Summer was the sacred fuel, and Autumn was the oblation.
Seven were its fencing sticks of the altar; thrice seven (twenty-one) were the sacred fuels prepared.
When the divine beings, extending the sacrifice, bound the Purusha as the offering.

chunks.sanskrit: तं य॒ज्ञं ब॒र्हिषि॒ प्रौक्षन्᳚ । पुरु॑षं जा॒तम॑ग्र॒तः ।
chunks.translation: They consecrated Him upon the sacred kusha grass — the primordial Cosmic Person born in the beginning.

chunks.sanskrit: तेन॑ दे॒वा अय॑जन्त । सा॒ध्या ऋष॑यश्च॒ ये ॥ ८ ॥
chunks.translation: With Him as the offering, the Devas, the Sadhyas, and the illumined Rishis performed the holy rite.
From that universally offered sacrifice was gathered the speckled clarified butter.
And He created the creatures of the air, the wild beasts of the forest, and domestic animals of the village.
From that universal sacrifice sprang the Rigvedic hymns and the melodies of Samaveda.
From it were born the sacred poetic meters (Chandas); from it was born the Yajurveda.
From Him were born horses, and all creatures possessing two rows of teeth.

chunks.sanskrit: गावो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा᳚त् । तस्मा᳚ज्जा॒ता अ॑जा॒वयः॑ ॥ ११ ॥
chunks.translation: From Him sprang the kine; from Him were born goats and sheep.
When they contemplated the Purusha, into how many portions did they conceive Him?

chunks.sanskrit: मुखं॒ किम॑स्य॒ कौ बा॒हू । कावू॒रू पादा॑वुच्येते ॥ १२ ॥
chunks.translation: What became His mouth? What His arms? What were His thighs and feet called?
His mouth became the Brahmana (voice of wisdom); His arms were made the Rajanya (protectors).

chunks.sanskrit: ऊ॒रू तद॑स्य॒ यद्वैश्यः॑ । प॒द्भ्यां शू॒द्रो अ॑जायत ॥ १३ ॥
chunks.translation: His thighs became the Vaishya (providers of commerce); from His feet the Shudra (foundation of service) was born.

chunks.sanskrit: च॒न्द्रमा॒ मन॑सो जा॒तः । चक्षोः॒ सूर्यो॑ अजायत ।
chunks.translation: The moon was born from His mind; from His cosmic eye the radiant Sun was born.
From His mouth came Indra and Agni; and from His sacred breath the Wind (Vayu) was born.
From His navel arose the intermediate atmospheric realm; from His head the heavens were unfolded.

chunks.sanskrit: प॒द्भ्यां भूमि॒र्दिशः॒ श्रोत्रा᳚त् । तथा॑ लो॒काꣳ अ॑कल्पयन् ॥ १५ ॥
chunks.translation: From His feet came the earth; from His hearing the cardinal directions. Thus they established the worlds.

chunks.sanskrit: वेदा॒हमे॒तं पुरु॑षं म॒हान्तम्᳚ । आ॒दि॒त्यव॑र्णं॒ तम॑स॒स्तु पा॒रे ।
chunks.translation: I have realized this Supreme Person, resplendent like the golden Sun, beyond all darkness.

chunks.sanskrit: सर्वा॑णि रू॒पाणि॑ वि॒चित्य॒ धीरः॑ । नामा॑नि कृ॒त्वा॒ऽभि॒वद॒न् यदास्ते᳚ ॥ १६ ॥
chunks.translation: Having shaped all forms, the wise Creator gives them names and continues to converse through them.
Whom the Creator Brahma celebrated of old, and whom Indra perceived in the four cosmic quarters.

chunks.sanskrit: तमे॒वं वि॒द्वान॒मृत॑ इ॒ह भ॑वति । नान्यः पन्था॑ अय॒नाय॑ विद्यते ॥ १७ ॥
chunks.translation: Knowing Him thus, one attains immortality even here; there is no other path to the Supreme Liberation.

chunks.sanskrit: य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त दे॒वाः । तानि॒ धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मान्या॑सन् ।
chunks.translation: With sacrifice the Devas worshipped the Sacrifice; those were the primordial cosmic laws (Dharmas).

chunks.sanskrit: ते ह॒ नाकं॑ महि॒मानः॑ सचन्ते । यत्र॒ पूर्वे॑ सा॒ध्याः सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः ॥ १८ ॥
chunks.translation: Those exalted beings attain the highest realm of light, where the ancient Sadhyas and Devas abide.
